item.title: Scientists activate unusual magnetism in ultrathin material
item.description: Researchers have discovered a surprising method to potentially activate a rare form of magnetism in ruthenium dioxide, a material typically non-magnetic.

item.title: Astronomers spot Betelgeuse's hidden companion
item.description: Astronomers have obtained the clearest image yet of Betelgeuse's long-suspected companion, potentially ending a century-long search.
